# StackSplit

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Imaging` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public readonly record struct StackSplit
```

A recipe's reference layers split around the one being edited: what paints under it, and what paints over it.

The split is the whole point of the feature — sunglasses sit above a face and below a hat, so a single flat underlay would show neither correctly. It is also the shape the caching wants: the two stacks are composited once each and reused across every brush stroke, invalidated only when the reference *selection* changes.
